searchText: Agreed. It could fit cleanly into a phased rollout: Disallow (8365) -> Retire (8433) -> Recovery, giving validators plenty of time to migrate organically before we deal with whatever tail remains. It would use the credibility of TheDao to handle the offchain/social part, not burden the core devs, and putting the yield to good use
